summary: Dispatcher-style critical-section leave helper (cdecl), paired with the enter helper. Takes an index a1 and a context pointer a2. When a1 >= 20 it calls the imported LeaveCriticalSection on the LPCRITICAL_SECTION at a2 + 32; otherwise it delegates to CritSectLeave(a1 + 28), the lazy-init path. Callers include file and stream I/O paths.

operations.description: Dispatch on a1 >= 20: high indices use the direct path, low indices use the lazy-init path.
Direct path computes the LPCRITICAL_SECTION pointer as a2 + 32.
Direct path calls the imported LeaveCriticalSection (function pointer global 0x0059E170) on the critical section at a2 + 32.
Lazy path computes the per-index critical-section slot address as a1 + 28.
Lazy path calls CritSectLeave(a1 + 28) to release the critical section for indices below 20.
Invoked by FileOpWithGlobalBuffer (0x00588821), sub_58A0BF (0x0058A0BF) and sub_58C5AC (0x0058C5AC) to release their critical sections after buffered file operations.

unresolved: Exact meaning of a1 (critical-section array index) and a2 (context/base) depends on the three callers.
Why 20 slots are handled by the lazy-init array while higher indices use the direct path is caller-data dependent.
